name: davservices/davservices
description: WebDAV, CalDAV and CardDAV server framework for PHP — no runtime dependencies.

suggest.ext-intl: Speeds up i;unicode-casemap collation. Results are identical without it.
suggest.ext-openssl: Required only if you use the bundled TLS-capable transports.
suggest.ext-pdo: Required only for the bundled PDO reference backends.

scripts-descriptions.style: Checks PHP coding style without changing files and shows the required diff.
scripts-descriptions.style:fix: Automatically fixes PHP coding style violations.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Runs PHPStan at the configured strictness level.
scripts-descriptions.check: Runs every gate the CI pipeline enforces. Needs Xdebug, because the coverage floor is one of them.
scripts-descriptions.check:deps: Fails if any production file references a class outside DavServices\ or the PHP core.
scripts-descriptions.check:namespace: Fails if src/ contains a namespace other than DavServices\.
scripts-descriptions.check:terms: Fails if application-layer vocabulary leaks into the protocol library.
scripts-descriptions.check:layers: Fails on a dependency pointing from a lower layer to a higher one.
scripts-descriptions.check:metadata: Fails if composer.json is not strictly valid.
scripts-descriptions.check:autoload: Loads every class through the bundled autoloader, without Composer.
scripts-descriptions.check:coverage: Enforces the coverage floor against an existing Clover report.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Runs PHPUnit with line and branch coverage, writes the reports and enforces the floor.
scripts-descriptions.mutation: Runs Infection mutation testing and enforces the configured mutation score thresholds.
